title: Independently re-reviewed documentary coverage evidence
method: Existing coverage eligibility was independently re-reviewed on 2026-10-08 against the sources listed per record. Sources include Google, official partners/governments, primary research and original reporting; source types and limits are explicit. No GeoGuessr eligibility table is used as evidence in this revision. This is not a claim of clean-room original app creation or legal clearance. Specialist-community references are used for the four entries explicitly marked independently-supported-road; only brief factual eligibility summaries and links are included.
criterion: Documented released official Google or official-partner road imagery, with explicit limited/mixed street-Trekker exceptions for Faroe Islands and the 15-town Greenland whitelist. Country inclusion does not establish every street or city is covered.

statusDefinitions.confirmed: Documentary release evidence supports roads; no current live-panorama or every-city verification.
statusDefinitions.limited: Explicitly limited geographic/scope evidence; consult source type and notes.
statusDefinitions.documentary-supported-road: Medium-confidence original reporting supports road release.
statusDefinitions.documentary-supported-limited-road: Medium-confidence partner-announcement reporting and original observation support some streets.
statusDefinitions.independently-supported-road: Medium-confidence specialist-community documentation supports official road imagery; not a primary Google release verification or every-city claim.
